meta.title: Humanize
meta.description: Mark human-facing writes, review delivered prose against PROSE.md, and merge annotations.

settings.reviewProvider: Review model provider. Leave empty to follow the model currently used by the session.
settings.reviewModel: Review model. Leave empty to follow the model currently used by the session.
settings.reviewReasoningEffort: Reasoning effort for the review model. Leave empty to use the model's own default.
settings.mergeProvider: Model provider for merge subagents. Leave empty to follow the model currently used by the session.
settings.mergeModel: Model for merge subagents. Leave empty to follow the model currently used by the session.
settings.mergeReasoningEffort: Reasoning effort for merge subagents. Leave empty to follow the reasoning effort currently used by the session.
settings.reviewConcurrency: Maximum number of concurrent review calls. All review calls share this limit. Choose a value appropriate for the model provider's rate limits.
settings.reviewRetries: Number of retries. A review is marked as failed after all retries are exhausted.
settings.reviewIntervalSeconds: Minimum interval between reviews, counted from the end of the previous review. Writes arriving during the interval are combined into the next review.
settings.loopMaxRounds: Maximum number of rounds in a merge loop.
settings.mergeOnCompaction: Automatically merge staged annotations when context compaction finishes.
settings.storageDir: Where staged annotations are stored. Leave empty to use the default location ~/.dsh/humanize. Relative paths are resolved against the process working directory.
